scope: one-card real graph bind and split-bank replay census; four-rank row-4 ledger remains a box gate

leaves.leaf: SimpleNamespace manager and FULL capture descriptor
leaves.replaces: vLLM CudagraphManager and FULL CudagraphCaptureDesc created during the split-bank model capture
leaves.equivalence: The fields read by the generated worker hook and real ObserverSession.bind_bank have the same identity and stream shape; the graph capture, CUDA handle and native observer binding themselves are real. Model descriptor generation is outside this proof.

leaves.leaf: SplitDecodeBank allocated without its model-dependent constructor/capture
leaves.equivalence: The bank, SplitGraphHandle and SplitDecodeBank.replay method are actual classes; their pairs/handles carry the same object identities used by NativeIdentity and ReplaySession. The fixture skips model graph capture and full bank setup, so it cannot qualify the box composition.

leaves.leaf: SimpleNamespace native lane and probe shell
leaves.replaces: WorkerNative, native qualification RPC identity and row-4 probe fields
leaves.equivalence: The actual NativeIdentity router view is constructed against the real bank handle; the probe supplies only the epoch/generation/route fields checked by bind_bank. RPC ordering and engine-offer ledger setup are deferred.

It is a real PyTorch CUDAGraph on the declared green decode stream. The real SplitDecodeBank.replay enqueues it and increments the actual handle counter; graph node census and model numerics are not exercised.
The replay counter and observer reader are rank-local. Cross-rank offer agreement and placement require the box.
